messages:
Maria (growth): Heads-up — I’m seeing a ~14% dip in MQL->SQL conversion for the March 8 cohort on the cohort dashboard. Flagging before the weekly KPI review. Anyone else seeing this?

Ajay (analytics): Yup I see it. Cohort row looks off compared to previous weeks. Numbers: leads 842 -> SQLs 103 (was ~120 last week). Link: https://redwood.app/dash/cohorts?cohort=2026-03-08 :thinking:

Olivia (demand-gen): That cohort includes webinar signups right? We did a paid boost that day. Could be traffic quality / UTM issues. Have we confirmed source tags landed correctly? :mag:

Ajay (analytics): Quick check SQL I ran:
```
SELECT cohort_date, count(*) as leads, sum((status = 'sql')::int) as sqls
FROM leads
WHERE cohort_date = '2026-03-08'
GROUP BY cohort_date;
```
I can export raw rows if helpful. Results match the dashboard.

Jordan (ops): FYI we flipped an inbound routing rule on 2026-03-07 that routes webinar traffic to the new SDR pool (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/route/432). Could be a mismatch in assignment tags that breaks downstream conversion reporting.

Olivia (demand-gen): Good catch @Jordan. If the SDR tag changed, the attribution join could be failing. I’ll re-check UTM->lead_source mapping in the form handler (iframe) — saw a small change in the embed last week.

Maria (growth): Can someone pull the raw lead CSV for that cohort and the utm fields? I want to sanity-check utm_source/medium/campaign and the assigned_owner field. Add to the KPI review agenda if we can’t resolve today.

Ajay (analytics): I’ll export CSV and run grouping by utm_campaign and assigned_owner. Quick grouping query I’ll run first: 
```
SELECT utm_campaign, assigned_owner, count(*)
FROM leads_raw
WHERE cohort_date = '2026-03-08'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 3 DESC;
```
Will post results in ~20m.

kpi-bot: Cohort conversion alert triggered — cohort_date=2026-03-08, conversion_drop=14%, threshold=10%. See /alerts/cohort-conversion for details.

Jordan (ops): If assigned_owner is null for a chunk, routing likely failed. I’ll audit the routing logs for 03-07 -> 03-09 window and share a tail of the logs.

Olivia (demand-gen): Also note: we switched the webinar landing page variant A/B that morning (variant B used a different hidden field name). That could break the utm passthrough. Adding that as a hypothesis.

Maria (growth): Good list of hypotheses: 1) routing change -> null assignment, 2) embed/landing variant broke UTM mapping, 3) traffic quality shift from paid boost, 4) attribution window edge-case (last-touch window ending).

Ajay (analytics): Preliminary export attached (snippet):
"utm_campaign","assigned_owner","count"
"webinar-march8","sdr-team-alpha",512
"webinar-march8","",248
"organic-blog","sdr-team-alpha",82
So ~30% of webinar leads have blank owner — that aligns with the drop.

Jordan (ops): Confirmed — logs show a 10:32 AM spike of 5xx from the routing service tied to the new rule. I’ll revert the rule for a short window and reprocess the delayed queue. PR ready: https://git.redwood/infra/route/433 (revert).

Olivia (demand-gen): I’ll pause the paid boost for the remainder of the day and notify the paid channels. Also will patch the landing variant to restore the hidden field name.

Maria (growth): Thanks team. Action items: Ajay — full CSV to the #marketing-data-drive folder + anomaly slides for KPI review. Jordan — revert & reprocess + post runbook steps. Olivia — update landing & pause paid. I’ll add a 10-min slot to Friday’s KPI review for a quick postmortem.

Ajay (analytics): Will do. If reprocess fixes owner assignment, conversion should rebound. I’ll include a comparison chart (pre/post reprocess) in the deck.

kpi-bot: Noted — task check created: CRO-1427 "Investigate cohort conversion drop (2026-03-08)". Assigned: Ajay, Jordan, Olivia, Maria. Due: 2026-03-12.

Maria (growth): Great. Lets reconvene after reprocess. If anyone sees anything else in the meantime drop in this thread. :thumbsup:
